passive.name: Dispossession
passive.text: The wearer's base SPD increases by **12/14/16/18/20**. When dealing DMG, ignores **18/22.5/27/31.5/36%** of the target's DEF. After the wearer uses Ultimate, gains "Blazing Sun," which is removed at the start of the turn. While holding "Blazing Sun," increases the wearer's DMG dealt by **60/78/96/114/132%**.

weapons.name: On the Fall of an Aeon

passive.name: Moth to Flames
passive.text: When the wearer attacks, increases their ATK by **8/10/12/14/16%** in this battle. This effect can stack up to **4** time(s). After the wearer breaks an enemy's Weakness, increases DMG dealt by **12/15/18/21/24%**, lasting for **2** turn(s).

passive.name: Spare No Effort
passive.text: Increases DMG dealt by the wearer by **20/25/30/35/40%**. The wearer also deals an extra **20/25/30/35/40%** of DMG to enemies whose current HP percentage is equal to or higher than the wearer's current HP percentage.

substatLine: SPD (Breakpoint) > CRIT Rate = CRIT DMG > ATK%

entries.name: E—Excuse Me, Please!
entries.text: Deals Ice DMG equal to **100%** of Misha's ATK to one designated enemy target.

entries.name: R—Room Service!
entries.text: Increases the Hits Per Action for Misha's next Ultimate by **1** hit(s). Deals Ice DMG equal to **200%** of Misha's ATK to one designated enemy target, and Ice DMG equal to **80%** of Misha's ATK to adjacent targets.

entries.name: G—Gonna Be Late!
entries.text:
Has **3** Hits Per Action by default. First, uses 1 hit to deal Ice DMG equal to **60%** of Misha's ATK to one designated enemy target. Then, the rest of the hits each deals Ice DMG equal to **60%** of Misha's ATK to one random enemy. Just before each hit lands, there is a **20%** base chance to Freeze the target, lasting for 1 turn.
While Frozen, enemy targets cannot take any actions, and at the start of their turn, they receive Ice Additional DMG equal to **30%** of Misha's ATK.
This Ultimate can possess up to **10** Hits Per Action. After the Ultimate is used, its Hits Per Action will be reset to the default level.

entries.name: Horological Escapement
entries.text: For every 1 Skill Point allies consume, Misha's next Ultimate delivers **1** more Hit(s) Per Action, and Misha regenerates **2** Energy.

entries.name: Wait, You Are So Beautiful!
entries.text: After using the Technique, creates a Special Dimension that lasts for **15** seconds. Enemies caught in the Special Dimension are inflicted with Dream Prison and stop all their actions. Upon entering battle against enemies afflicted with Dream Prison, increases the Hits Per Action for Misha's next Ultimate by **2** hit(s). Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

entries.name: Release
entries.text: Before the Ultimate's first hit, increases the base chance of Freezing the target by **80%**.

entries.name: Interlock
entries.text: When using the Ultimate, increases the Effect Hit Rate by **60%**, lasting until the end of the current Ultimate's action.

entries.name: Transmission
entries.text: When dealing DMG to Frozen enemies, increases CRIT DMG by **30%**.

entries.name: Whimsicality of Fancy
entries.text: When using the Ultimate, for every enemy on the field, additionally increases the Hits Per Action for the current Ultimate by 1 hit(s), up to a maximum increase of 5 hit(s).

entries.name: Yearning of Youth
entries.text: Before each hit of the Ultimate lands, there is a 24% base chance of reducing the target's DEF by 16% for 3 turn(s).

entries.name: Vestige of Happiness
entries.text:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

entries.name: Visage of Kinship
entries.text: Increases the DMG multiplier for each hit of the Ultimate by 6%.

entries.name: Genesis of First Love
entries.text:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

entries.name: Estrangement of Dream
entries.text: When using the Ultimate, increases own DMG by 30%, lasting until the end of the turn. In addition, the next time the Skill is used, recovers 1 Skill Point(s) for the team.
